Source: National Center for Health Statistics, National Post-acute and Long-term Care Study, 2018, 2020, and 2022 data.
Percentage of Residential Care Communities* That Use Electronic Health Records, by Community Bed Size
Use of EHRs increased during this time regardless of RCC size, and larger RCCs were more likely to use EHRs compared with smaller RCCs.
Source: National Center for Health Statistics, National Post-acute and Long-term Care Study, 2018, 2020, and 2022 data.
From 2018 to 2022, the percentage of residential care communities (RCCs) using electronic health records (EHRs) increased from 36% to 48%.

methods_quotes.q: Residential care communities with missing data were excluded.
